title: Open a sidebar photo on the map and pan it
steps: Inspect the open landscape photo and the Location Information mini-map in its sidebar.
Click the Location Information mini-map to open the photo on the full map.
Swipe the full map to the left.

video_guide.summary: Watch the blue photo marker and the details card as the map moves. The card stays near the center while its marker moves away.

chapters.note: The sidebar shows Failed to load image; the photo and location mini-map remain visible. This is separate from the map-card alignment being reviewed.
The landscape card and blue photo marker are both visible on the map.
The blue marker is left of the card, separated from its lower anchor.
The card remains near the center while the blue marker is offset to its left.
